claims.subject: ruzi

evidence.quote: As Master Trainer, Ruzi taught the youngest Selesnyans and their wolves to become Wolf Riders.

claims.summary: Ruzi is the Selesnya Master Trainer of Wolf Riders.

evidence.quote: the three of them—Cecilee, Ruzi, and his wolf Kuma—had been inseparable
Cecilee named the child after her brother, Ruzi

claims.subject: nikya

evidence.quote: She explained that Nikya claimed the boy as kin and demanded he be raised as Gruul.

claims.summary: Nikya claims the child as kin and demands he be raised Gruul.

claims.subject: massacre_girl

evidence.quote: She didn't know the woman was a for-hire Rakdos killer who called herself Massacre Girl.

claims.summary: Massacre Girl is a for-hire Rakdos killer (as of this story).

claims.subject: massacre_girl

evidence.quote: The two surprised Massacre Girl and her men as they searched the bodies for anything valuable.
Ruzi glimpsed the bodies of his fellows Selesnyans near the desecrated guild-tree.

claims.summary: Massacre Girl and her men are found among the Selesnyan dead at the desecrated guild-tree.
claims.limitation: The page implies, but these lines do not state, that she carried out the killings.

evidence.quote: The artificial, metal plane of Mirrodin was created by the planeswalker Karn.

claims.subject: karn

evidence.quote: Karn also created an artifact warden to watch over the plane while he explored the multiverse.
Karn transformed the remains of Memnarch into the metal sphere they had once been: the Mirari.

claims.summary: Karn created an artifact warden for Mirrodin, which became Memnarch (as of 2008).
claims.limitation: The warden-to-Memnarch identity is implied across sentences.

claims.subject: dyfed

evidence.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed took Yawgmoth to Phyrexia shortly after its creator and master had died

claims.summary: Dyfed took Yawgmoth to Phyrexia during the Thran decline.

claims.subject: yawgmoth

evidence.quote: The Thran were defeated, but not before the portal was closed, trapping Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians in their plane.

claims.summary: Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians were trapped in Phyrexia when the portal closed.

evidence.quote: This artificial plane was created by the planeswalker Serra to exemplify her love of peace and law.

claims.subject: obzedat

evidence.quote: I have come from the ghost halls of the Obzedat with a message for Teysa Karlov.
Teysa Karlov must find the correct route and complete the maze at all costs.

claims.summary: A messenger from the Obzedat tells Teysa Karlov she must complete the maze (2013 feature).
claims.limitation: Rendered as a command from the Obzedat; the feature frames it as a message.
